title: Add consumer registry and topology coverage check
context: Extend the repository registry with layer/dependency metadata and verify coverage

spec.summary: Add consumer registry and topology coverage check
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Every repository in the manifest appears in the registry/topology.
Extra registry/topology entries fail the check.
Layer and dependency data is machine-readable.
The check reports missing or duplicate repositories.
Backup/tag verification can use the same registry.
Choose registry vs topology as the source of truth.
Wire it into the manual backup/tag run.
A temporary missing entry fails the check.
